notes.title: ver 1.0.7 Gamepad Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Gamepad 
Fixed an issue in which the cross key would work even if another key was assigned to “Switch to Primary Weapon”. 

Fixed an issue in which the cross key would work even if another key was assigned to “Switch to Secondary Weapon”. 

Fixed an issue where the start button cannot be assigned in the gamepad key bindings settings.

notes.title: HOTFIX ver 1.0.4 Disable "Send play log"
notes.notes:
In HOLE ver1.0.3, there is an issue where the game cannot be started in some environments.
We are currently investigating the issue.

It seems that the problem is probably due to the "Send play log" added in ver1.0.3, so we will temporarily disable this system.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: UPDATE ver 1.0.3 Dragon's Breath & More
notes.notes:
Thank you for waiting! 
This is the first update to add new content to HOLE!

We hope all the players who have already played through HOLE will enjoy it.
And thank you for all the warm reviews!


Gameplay

 Added melee attacks (kicks) for player
 Added new enemy NPCs
 Added new weapon parts
 Added extras when all tasks are completed.
 Added a release order for blueprints for magazines only.
 Added sound to the microwave.


Balance adjustment

 Reduced stun power of 5.56x45mm AP from 10 to 6
 Increased the number of microwaves in drainage system from 2 to 3.
 Reduced the number of microwaves  in apartments from 5 to 3.


Options

 Game: Added log transmission setting.
 Audio: Added UI sound


Localization

 Added Chinese (Simplified/Traditional)


UI

 Changed icon for key input
 Added manual save to pause menu
 Added wave count and kill total to result screen
 Added language selection popup on first launch


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with sprint toggle not releasing sprint
 Fixed an issue where NPCs would attack after jumping into a hole


Other

 Adjusted magnification of 4x scope

notes.title: UPDATE ver 1.0.2 Bug fixes & Option Name Changes
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update fixes some issues reported by players and changes some misleading option names.
Thank you for reporting the issues in reviews and threads!

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where crouching while jumping would cause the player to fall over.
 Fixed an issue with pop-ups not displaying correctly when purchasing drinks in succession


Other

 The ‘Navigation Icon’ in the Options section has been renamed to ‘Exit Progress Bar’.
 Chemical light added near locked door in Drainage System.

notes.title: UPDATE ver 1.0.1 OPTION : Camera Shake & More
notes.notes:
Hello!

It has been a week since the release and we are surprised to receive so many reviews.
Those reviews also helped us in implementing this update.
Thank you very much!

Changes

Option

 Graphics : Camera shake (Default: 0.5)
 Control : Mouse smoothing (Default: OFF)
 Control : Disable control axis rotation in lean (Default: OFF)


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug in the mannequin's leg.
 Fixed a problem with some walls in the office penetrating bullets


Other

 Increased transparency of sight lenses by 30%

We hope you enjoy the casual & hard shooting! (Attention jams)
